description: Rerun of covid_first_look_v3 after two incubation corrections (#547): an infection with no inoculum on record (the declared index case) is drawn at the reference dose instead of the literal-zero floor (SARS-CoV-2 median 5.8 d, not 14.5 d), and the composite-Theta arm re-references its incubation dose term to the N50 of the exponential dose-response it installs (ln 2 / Theta), so secondary cases are no longer all drawn at the 2.5x ceiling. v3 cells carried both defects: takeoff was decided by the index case's incubation draw and the generation interval conditional on takeoff was ~13 d. Same grid, same matched seeds, same objective; v3 and v4 cells are paired by (Theta, seed).

grid.note: Half-decade points from 1e4 to 1e9; the single-seed fit's grid with the midpoints added.

fit.note: Matched seeds: every candidate sees the same 20 seeds, so candidate differences are paired.

held_out.note: Scored at the fitted Theta and reported at its half-decade neighbours as sensitivity; the rest of the grid is stored, not scored.
